title: Tekken 3 in your browser
intro: DriftEngine rebuilds Tekken 3 as a modern browser game. Fighters, moves, stages, music, voices and movies are read from your own disc image and played at your display's resolution.

chapters.title: From your disc
chapters.body: The hub converts your Tekken 3 USA disc once, which takes a few minutes. A Tekken 3 arcade dump (TET1) optionally adds the arcade's stages and models.

chapters.title: Runs in the browser
chapters.body: Play starts the game's server in the background and opens it in Chrome or Edge, at your screen's full resolution.

chapters.title: Keep the hub open
chapters.body: The hub serves the game while you play. Stop, or closing the hub, ends it.
